The '''2012–13 Czech First League''', known as the [[Gambrinus (beer)|Gambrinus]] liga for sponsorship reasons, was the 20th season of the [[Czech Republic]]'s top-tier [[Association football|football]] league. The defending champions were [[FC Slovan Liberec|Liberec]], who won their third Czech First League title the previous season.

A number of games were postponed due to adverse weather conditions. On 18 March the game between Jihlava and Mladá Boleslav was postponed due to heavy snow.<ref>{{cite news |first1=Petr|last1=Šedivý|first2=Michal|last2=Jindra|url=https://fotbal.idnes.cz/jihlava-mlada-boleslav-20-kolo-fotbalove-gambrinus-ligy-p1c-/fotbal.aspx?c=A130318_164840_fotbal_pes|title=Přívaly sněhu odložily fotbalovou dohrávku Jihlava – Mladá Boleslav|language=cs|publisher=idnes.cz|date=18 March 2013|access-date=10 May 2013}}</ref> A second game was postponed, before, on 10 May 2013, the match between Dukla Prague and Brno became the third match to be postponed, this time due to a waterlogged pitch.<ref>{{cite news |first=Petr|last=Šedivý|url=https://fotbal.idnes.cz/odlozeny-zapas-fotbalove-ligy-dukla-brno-fpb-/fotbal.aspx?c=A130510_164750_fotbal_pes|title=Vydatný déšť odložil páteční předehrávku fotbalové ligy Dukla – Brno|language=cs|publisher=idnes.cz|date=10 May 2013|access-date=10 May 2013}}</ref>

Title sponsor Gambrinus introduced {{lang|cs|Pivo za bůra}}, an initiative when after a team scored five goals in a league game, fans at the game received a voucher to buy a Gambrinus beer for the symbolic price of 5 [[Czech koruna]] before their next home match.<ref>{{cite news |title=Pivo za bůra, prezentace Gambrinus ligy by měla být jako v bundeslize |url=https://isport.blesk.cz/clanek/fotbal-gambrinus-liga-rocnik-12-13/127068/pivo-za-bura-prezentace-gambrinus-ligy-by-mela-byt-jako-v-bundeslize.html |access-date=20 May 2025 |work=Blesk |publisher=Czech News Center |date=25 July 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250520180228/https://isport.blesk.cz/clanek/fotbal-gambrinus-liga-rocnik-12-13/127068/pivo-za-bura-prezentace-gambrinus-ligy-by-mela-byt-jako-v-bundeslize.html |archive-date=20 May 2025 |language=cs |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="millionthfan">{{cite news |title=Sto piv pro milióntého diváka Gambrinus ligy si vypije fanoušek Plzně |url=https://www.sport.cz/clanek/fotbal-ceska-1-liga-sto-piv-pro-milionteho-divaka-gambrinus-ligy-si-vypije-fanousek-plzne-477538 |access-date=20 May 2025 |work=Sport.cz |publisher=Borgis |date=12 May 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250520181325/https://www.sport.cz/clanek/fotbal-ceska-1-liga-sto-piv-pro-milionteho-divaka-gambrinus-ligy-si-vypije-fanousek-plzne-477538?noredirect=1 |archive-date=20 May 2025 |language=cs |url-status=live}}</ref> During the course of the season, Slavia Prague (twice),<ref>{{cite web |title=Za pět gólů Gambrinus za bůra! |url=https://www.slavia.cz/article/10997-Za-pet-golu-Gambrinus-za-bura |website=Slavia Prague |access-date=20 May 2025 |language=cs |date=10 August 2012}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Ve středu akce Gambrinusu Pivo za bůra |url=https://www.slavia.cz/article/11625-Ve-stredu-akce-Gambrinusu-Pivo-za-bura |website=Slavia Prague |access-date=20 May 2025 |language=cs |date=21 May 2013}}</ref> Zbrojovka Brno,<ref>{{cite web |title=Zbrojováci vystříleli pivo za bůra |url=https://www.fczbrno.cz/clanek.asp?id=225 |website=Zbrojovka Brno |access-date=20 May 2025 |language=cs |date=29 September 2012}}</ref> Sigma Olomouc<ref>{{cite web |title=V neděli na Sigmě akce Pivo za bůra |url=https://sigmafotbal.cz/article/6115-V-nedeli-na-Sigme-akce-Pivo-za-bura |website=Sigma Olomouc |access-date=20 May 2025 |language=cs |date=16 November 2012}}</ref> and Dukla Prague<ref>{{cite web |title=Fanoušci Dukly Praha se mohou těšit na pivo za bůra |url=https://fkdukla.cz/article/1036-Fanousci-Dukly-Praha-se-mohou-tesit-na-pivo-za-bura |website=Dukla Prague |access-date=20 May 2025 |language=cs |date=15 April 2013}}</ref> all managed to score five or more goals in a single game to qualify fans in attendance for the offer. Gambrinus also awarded the millionth spectator of the season, a fan of [[FC Viktoria Plzeň|Viktoria Plzeň]], a voucher for 100 beers.<ref name="millionthfan"/>

==Teams==
[[FK Viktoria Žižkov|Viktoria Žižkov]] and [[Bohemians 1905]] were relegated to the 2012–13 [[Czech 2. Liga]] after finishing last and second to last, respectively, in the [[2011–12 Czech First League|2011–12 season]]. Žižkov therefore immediately returned to the second tier, while Bohemians left after a three-year spell in the top flight.

The relegated teams were replaced by [[2011–12 Czech 2. Liga|2011–12 2. Liga]] runners-up [[FC Vysočina Jihlava|Jihlava]] and fourth placed [[FC Zbrojovka Brno|Zbrojovka Brno]], who were promoted in place of 2. Liga winners [[FK Ústí nad Labem]], whose stadium did not satisfy league requirements.<ref>{{cite news |first=Jaromír|last=Novák|url=https://fotbal.idnes.cz/fotbalove-brno-se-vraci-do-prvni-ligy-dsw-/fotbal.aspx?c=A120606_094813_fotbal_mn|title=Brno postupuje do první ligy, Ústí doplatilo na nevyhovující stadion|language=cs|publisher=idnes.cz|date=6 June 2012|access-date=15 June 2012}}</ref> Brno thus returned to the top flight after a one-year absence. Jihlava, having last played in the top flight in the [[2005–06 Czech First League|2005–06 season]], returned after a six-season absence.
